f_Sun_0: Sun. The Sun is a star! About 1.3 million Earths could fit inside it.
f_Mercury_0: Mercury. Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
f_Venus_0: Venus. A day on Venus is longer than its whole year!
f_Mars_0: Mars. Mars looks red because of rusty dust.
f_Jupiter_0: Jupiter. Jupiter is the biggest planet. About 1,300 Earths could fit inside!
f_Uranus_0: Uranus. Uranus spins tipped over on its side.
f_Neptune_0: Neptune. Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun.
lab_earth: A blue home with a tilted axis. One side faces daylight; the other turns into night.
lab_moon: One rocky companion, many changing shapes. The Moon reflects sunlight; it does not make its own.
lab_seasons: Move Earth around the Sun. See how tilt changes daylight. Then try an Earth with no tilt.
lab_phases: Move the Moon and watch from Earth. The Sun lights half the Moon. We see different amounts of that sunlit half.
lab_compare: Compare two nearby worlds. Your mass stays the same, but gravity changes your weight.
lab_try: Change one thing. Watch what happens. Then ask why.
lab_day: Turn the globe to find the boundary between day and night. Earth spins into sunlight and out again. The axis guide tilts about 23.4 degrees.
trip_earth: Our adventure starts at home. Tap Earth, the blue world!
trip_earth_found: You found our home! Earth has one Moon. Let’s visit it.
trip_moon: The Moon goes around Earth. Can you tap the Moon? You can use the Visit Moon button too.
trip_moon_found: Hello, Moon! Look at those craters. Rocks from space made these dents. The Moon is much farther from Earth than we show here.
trip_mars: Let’s zoom out to meet our neighbours. Find Mars, the red planet. Use Show me if you need a hand.
trip_mars_found: There is Mars! Rust in its rocks and dust makes it look red. You found another world!
trip_saturn: Now look for Saturn, the world with big, bright rings. Use Show me if you need a hand.
trip_saturn_found: You found Saturn! Its rings are made of many pieces of ice and rock.
trip_retry: A different world! Let’s look together.
trip_done: What an adventure! Earth, the Moon, Mars, and Saturn. Explore on your own now, or tap Replay to travel again.
trip_explore: Tap a world to discover a fact. Tap Adventure whenever you want our trip again.
